Its CNC-machined bits were selected through research into fasteners used in current and legacy consumer electronics. events.body:
The iFixit Pro Tech Toolkit starts with 64 CNC-machined bits selected through research into current and legacy consumer-electronics fasteners. It then adds the tools needed for work beyond turning screws.
